purpose: Prepare the synthetic data contract for Kent's EA-to-school-to-fee UAT flow.
mode: UI-seeded; do not insert directly into the database

preconditions.government_mock: Has a Singapore Citizen profile matching the student identity below; reuse the mock profile and its approved date of birth.
preconditions.daily_sync: Run only after confirming this profile has no existing EA; expect one Active EA with SGD 0.00 balance.
preconditions.school: Reuse the existing School Test 01 record; do not create a duplicate.
preconditions.school_user: Reuse the existing School User assigned to School Test 01; do not change shared role mappings.
preconditions.class: Reuse P1A if already present for the intended academic year; otherwise create it once under School Test 01.
preconditions.fee_configuration: Confirm Tuition fee type, component, and rate are configured before creating a publication.

student.date_of_birth: Reuse the matching Government API mock value; the UAT spec only requires that the student has just turned 7.

expected_links: Government mock identity -> one Active EA
School Test 01 -> student enrollment -> class P1A
Student identity -> the matching EA after class assignment

fee.name: Tuition fee
fee.publication: Create and publish only after verifying the student, enrollment, class, and EA links.

verification: EA is Active and starts at SGD 0.00 before any payment/top-up activity.
Student is linked to the matching EA after class assignment.
The published fee creates one POSTED Student Charge visible to the parent.
reset_scope: Remove only records created for this seed, in dependency order, after downstream charges/applications are cleared. Never reset shared school, student, EA, or fee records.
